objective: Fix the defects from audit C (verification/audit-C-2026-11-13.json) in the desktop hotkey/tray work. MAJORS: (1) desktop.py paste-back while the hotkey is held: results that arrive while any configured hotkey key is still physically held must be queued and pasted only after all keys are released (the PushToTalk machine knows the held set; expose a `held_keys()` accessor); additionally, immediately before sending Ctrl+V, release any still-held modifier keys (Alt/Shift/Ctrl, both sides) via SendInput key-up events carrying the hook MARKER so the hook ignores them, and restore nothing afterwards (the user has released them anyway). (2) Single instance: in run_desktop.py/desktop.main, create a named mutex 'Local\Voice2Txt-SingleInstance' with CreateMutexW; if GetLastError() == 183 (ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS), broadcast a registered window message RegisterWindowMessageW('Voice2TxtShowWindow') via PostMessageW(HWND_BROADCAST) and exit 0; the running instance's tray window WndProc handles that message by emitting the 'show' action. Keep the mutex handle alive for the process lifetime. MINORS: (3) hotkeys.py no-op injection: when the Alt key-up reaches the hook and the helper has not yet injected the no-op, wait for it with a bound of 25 ms (Event.wait) before passing the key-up on. (4) reset() must keep the currently held key set so keyboard auto-repeat after a stop is not treated as a new press; add a unit test (tap start, long-press stop, auto-repeat downs produce no new start). (5) Only the same combo that started a session can stop it by tap (spec), and a recording started with the button can be stopped by any configured combo tap; add tests. (6) Missed key-up recovery: on each tick, if GetAsyncKeyState reports a held key as up (only in the Win32 hook path; inject a `is_physically_down` callable into the machine so tests can simulate), drop it from the held set; plus a watchdog: if no hook callback has been seen for 10 s while keys are reported held, reinstall the hook. (7) tray.py TaskbarCreated: if NIM_ADD fails, try NIM_MODIFY and keep `added` true when either succeeds. (8) desktop.py start_at_login checkbox initial state comes from startup.is_enabled() at load (settings value is then synced to it); toggling still writes the registry immediately. (9) close(): after_cancel the pending _poll callback before destroying root so no Tcl 'invalid command name' is printed; verify with check_desktop_settings.py stderr being empty. (10) scripts/check_tray_indicator.py: temp registry key cleanup in a finally block; also delete the leftover empty key HKCU\Software\Voice2TxtCheck-abef8643 that an earlier run of this script left behind (only that exact key, created by our own script; record before/after in the JSON). (11) Typeless conflict warning: at startup (and when hotkeys change) check tasklist/EnumProcesses for 'Typeless.exe'; if running and any configured combo is a bare Right Alt or includes Right Alt, show a status warning '偵測到 Typeless 正在執行，Right Alt 會被它攔截；請改設其他快捷鍵或關閉 Typeless。' (pure function `conflicting_combos(process_names, combos)` with tests). Update verification JSONs by re-running scripts/check_hotkey_hook.py and scripts/check_tray_indicator.py, and add a new scripts/check_single_instance.py that launches two `run_desktop.py --minimized` processes, asserts the second exits 0 within 5 s and only one tray icon/hook process remains, then terminates the first; writes verification/single-instance-2026-11-13.json.
